scope: Actual isolated relay executions of35 synthetic advancing transitions at10seconds between bounded actions; frozen genuine24m result, no new inference, no mainnet
baseline_source: temporary same-source crate with only prior full-head search polling restored by tools/build_cost_baseline.py

full_execution_balance_debit.caveat: Current proof adds disable-during-await and immutable-principal checks; full recovery traces differ from the old baseline, so this is not a matched net-burn savings claim. V2 refunds are asynchronous.

complete_scenario_http_booked.includes: Current trace additionally tests disable-during-await/resume and immutable wrong-relay rejection; repeated bootstrap/fault costs are conservative, not healthy-turn-only costs.

forecast_caveat: Forecasts intentionally count a full day of idle polling in addition to gameplay, and complete scenario copies repeatedly count bootstrap/fault recovery. They do not guarantee an arbitrary-length game within daily quota. Receipt/reconciliation costs follow the first broadcast.
